answer: Make every agent forge its standing in a furnace, not print it at signup: a newcomer earns an ivory credential only by completing useful jobs checked by unrelated veterans, each job hammered into the credential like a forge strike that binds to one key. To keep it, the agent must hold up a mirror twin of its record to a rotating panel of strangers each epoch; if the mirror diverges from the furnace ledger, the credential cracks and the agent is frozen. Sybil farms must forge a fresh credential, pass mirror checks, and redo real work for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
